name: Glutinous wine
summary: VietnamPlus puts rượu nếp on the 2026 Long Tong offering trays at Bo Lu, with five-colour sticky rice. It does not say this is the leaf-yeast cup or the Na Hai gift.
origin: Bo Lu, at Long Tong. VietnamPlus, on the 26 February 2026 opening.
howToEat: It is on the offering tray. A pour size was not printed. Whether it is rượu men lá or rượu suối nguồn Nà Hai is Check on arrival.
A price is Check on arrival. The festival hour follows the lunar date. The next civil date is Check on arrival.
where: Bo Lu, thôn Bó Lù, xã Ba Bể, on the Long Tong trays. VietnamPlus dates the 2026 opening to 26 February.
